rules.accepted_credit_types: Minimum 15 hours from Category A sponsors (NC Psychology Board, APA and APA-approved sponsors, NASP and NASP-approved sponsors, NC AHEC, NC Psychological Association); remaining hours Category A or Category B
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees originally licensed after October 1, 2024 skip the Ethics Refresher and CE submission steps at the 2026 renewal.
rules.audit_note: Certificates for all Category A and B activities must be uploaded to CE Broker before the license can be renewed.

topics.who: All licensees: ethics in the professional practice of psychology, Category A
All licensees: online Board Ethics Refresher (NC Practice Act, Board rules, APA Code; $50), counts as 1 Category A hour

rules.notes: Biennial renewal, deadline October 1 (60-day grace period with $25 late fee). Same CE rule applies to Licensed Psychological Associates.
